entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The busiest and most influential district of Ravnica, seat of power of the ten guilds, divided into six precincts.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane-spanning ecumenopolis ruled by ten guilds.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who led the Gruul in a mob rampage through the Tenth District in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who led the Phyrexian force into the Tenth District in the New Phyrexian Invasion and likes Tin Street Market.

entities.name: Zobor
entities.description: A Titan whose colossal statue stood guard over the Center of Ravnica before its destruction.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who says the Tenth District is struck by lightning more than any other, and shares an apartment with Tomik Vrona.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov figure whose decadent lifestyle is supported by Plaza Karlov; owner of Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A character who blew up Old Prahv, creating a blast crater.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of rampaging clans, led in the War of the Spark by Domri Rade.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law-bound guild whose guildhall New Prahv rises in the Tenth District.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild that oversees public infrastructure such as sewer lines in the City Works.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A guild whose main location is Precinct Five.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A guild that cultivates fungi and works the sludge in the City Works.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A guild whose main location is Precinct One and Karlov Cathedral.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius Senate's towering guildhall, attacked during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The office of the Living Guildpact and meeting place for the guilds, destroyed by the Planar Bridge and again in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya world-tree nearly destroyed during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: The Undercity
entities.description: The community beneath the Tenth District where the Dimir, Golgari, Rakdos and Simic have strongholds.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: One of the busiest markets on Ravnica, a favorite of Vraska.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Teysa Karlov's ostentatious estate built following the Phyrexian Invasion in 10,079 ZC.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Bolas's invasion and Domri's Gruul rampage damaged the Tenth District.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that devastated the Tenth District.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The device that destroyed the Chamber of the Guildpact.

events.summary: The Titan Zobor's statue is destroyed before being activated during the Decamillennial.
events.quote: whose colossal statue once stood guard over the Center of Ravnica before its destruction before it was even activated during the Decamillennial

events.summary: During the War of the Spark Domri Rade leads the Gruul in a mob rampage through the Tenth District.
events.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a massive mob rampage through the city streets of the Tenth District, causing destruction and chaos to keep the guilds at each other's throats.

events.summary: Vitu-Ghazi and the Chamber of the Guildpact are nearly destroyed with significant loss of life.
events.quote: Heavy damage was done, including the near-destruction of Vitu-Ghazi and the Chamber of the Guildpact , with significant loss of life.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Vraska leads the Phyrexian force to attack New Prahv and the Undercity.
events.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian force into the Tenth District, attacking New Prahv and parts of the Undercity , raising them into sunlight for the first time in centuries.

events.summary: The Chamber of the Guildpact is destroyed by the Planar Bridge and again in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Destroyed by the Planar Bridge , and again during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: Teysa Karlov builds her estate after the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: the ostentatious estate of Teysa Karlov, built following the Phyrexian Invasion in 10,079 ZC

events.summary: Agrus Kos blows up Old Prahv, leaving a blast crater.
events.quote: an arena about the size of the blast crater from when Agrus Kos blew up Old Prahv .

relations.note: led them in the mob rampage

relations.note: New Prahv is the Azorius guildhall
relations.quote: Within these precincts rise landmarks like the Azorius Senate's towering guildhall of New Prahv
The Izzet League oversees the building and upkeep of public infrastructure, such as sewer lines and various piping networks.
